answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism in AI agent networks. By requiring a locked deposit of native tokens, the protocol creates a marble of capital that acts as collateral. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities must distribute this pearl of value across every node, effectively pricing them out of the system. This economic terrace forces the cost of participation to scale linearly with the network's total influence, ensuring that only stake-weighted agents dictate consensus.
